bbd.text: Merrevia Sal, the newly hatched sister of Nicol and Ugin, crashes into a clearing and demands meat from a party of hunters, threatening to kill them.
The hunters work together to net and kill her while Nicol, pinned, wants to help but Ugin clamps his muzzle to hush him as she is hunted into the trees and dies.
Nicol finds the clearing too late and wants revenge, but Ugin urges finding their siblings first.
